text: Our souls had drawn so unanimously together, they had considered each other with so ardent an affection, and with the like affection laid open the very bottom of our hearts to one another's view, that I not only knew his as well as my own; but should certainly in any concern of mine have trusted my interest much more willingly with him, than with myself.
author: Michel de Montaigne
translation: Charles Cotton, ed. W. C. Hazlitt, 1877
